content:
DOX framework (agent0ai/dox) integrated into all 28 coding skills across software-development, github, autonomous-ai-agents, and devops categories. Each skill now has a "DOX Integration" section with Read Before Editing / Update After Editing / Reference pattern.

Key technique: When skill_view fails on disabled skills, use read_file on absolute path ~/.hermes/skills/<cat>/<name>/SKILL.md. When patching many files at once, use mode='patch' with V4A format for batch operations.
